name: Skills for Designers and Engineers
summary: 14 agent skills that help coding agents make better UI and animation decisions, from easing curves to design review.
description: A set of 14 skills for designers and engineers building user interfaces: emil-design-eng (animation and design advice), animate, animate-expo, review-animations, improve-animations, find-animation-opportunities, animation-vocabulary, apple-design, write-swift, pick-ui-library, prototype, mobile-native, break-ui and ask-sonner. They encode rules for choosing the right easing, duration and properties, auditing motion in a codebase, and stress-testing UI with worst-case data.
contains: animation, motion and UI design guidance
based on experience at Vercel and Linear
